name: localhost-mcp
description: Inspect, manage, and kill local dev servers via MCP. Stop guessing what's on :3000.
long_description: MCP server that scans your local machine for running dev servers (next, vite, rails, django, etc) via lsof and ps. Five tools: list_dev_servers (full inventory), port_info (single port lookup), kill_server (safe kill, dry-run by default), find_zombies (forgotten processes), port_conflict (diagnose EADDRINUSE). All local, no cloud, no telemetry.

tools.name: list_dev_servers
tools.description: List all dev servers listening on TCP ports with port, pid, framework, project, uptime, mem, cpu.

tools.name: port_info
tools.description: Inspect a single port — who is holding it.

tools.name: kill_server
tools.description: Kill a dev server by pid or port. Dry-run by default; pass confirm=true to execute. Refuses pid<1000.

tools.name: find_zombies
tools.description: Find abandoned dev servers (high uptime, low CPU, lingering memory). Excludes IDE/LSP/agent/DB noise unless include_excluded=true.

tools.name: port_conflict
tools.description: Diagnose why a port is busy and suggest 5 free alternatives nearby.
